items.stem:
Below are three claims regarding the employees in a certain government ministry:
A. Tamar earns more than Yoav.
B. None of the employees in Yoav's department earns more than him.
C. Tamar does not work in Yoav's department.
Which of the following is true?
options: If claims B and C are true, claim A is also necessarily true
Claim B can be inferred from claims A and C
If claims A and B are true, there is no possibility that claim C is not true
None of the three claims can be inferred from the other two, but also none of them contradicts the other two
items.explanation: A and B: Tamar earns more than Yoav, and no one in his department does, so she is not in his department - C cannot be false (3). B and C say nothing about Tamar's salary (1), A and C say nothing about Yoav's colleagues (2), and (4) is false because C follows from A and B.
items.he_draft:
להלן שלוש טענות בנוגע לעובדים במשרד ממשלתי מסוים:
א. תמר משתכרת יותר מיואב.
ב. אף אחד מן העובדים במחלקה של יואב אינו משתכר יותר ממנו.
ג. תמר אינה עובדת במחלקה של יואב.
איזה מן המשפטים הבאים נכון?
(1) אם טענות ב ו-ג נכונות, גם טענה א נכונה בהכרח
(2) את טענה ב אפשר להסיק מטענות א ו-ג
(3) אם טענות א ו-ב נכונות, אין אפשרות שטענה ג אינה נכונה
(4) אף אחת משלוש הטענות אינה ניתנת להסקה משתי האחרות, אך גם אף אחת מהן אינה סותרת את שתי האחרות

items.stem: A museum lends paintings to exhibitions abroad. Of the six works by a certain painter in its collection, three are oil paintings and three are watercolors. This year one of the watercolors was being restored, and four of the other five works were sent to an exhibition in Paris. Which of the following is necessarily true?
options: Both watercolors that were not being restored were sent to Paris
Exactly one watercolor was shown in Paris
Most of the works sent to Paris were oil paintings
At least two oil paintings were sent to Paris
items.explanation: Five works were available: three oils and two watercolors. Four were sent, so at most two watercolors and at least two oils (4). Two and two, or three oils and one watercolor, are both possible, which refutes (1), (2) and (3).
items.he_draft: מוזיאון משאיל ציורים לתערוכות בחו"ל. מבין ששת הציורים של צייר מסוים שבאוספו, שלושה הם ציורי שמן ושלושה ציורי צבעי מים. השנה היה אחד מציורי צבעי המים בשימור, וארבעה מחמשת האחרים נשלחו לתערוכה בפריז. איזה מן הבאים נכון בהכרח?

items.stem: The advanced choir of a conservatory accepts only candidates who have passed an audition and, within a week of it, a written test in music theory. In addition, a candidate is accepted only if there is a free place in his voice range. Ronit passed both the audition and the written test, but was not accepted. Which of the following could explain this?
options: Ronit's audition took place three days before her written test
There was no free place in the voice range in which Ronit sings
Ronit's written test was graded only after the results of the auditions had been published
Ronit had applied to the choir a year earlier and had been rejected
items.explanation: The three conditions are necessary; the only one that (2) says was not met is the free place. In (1) the test came within a week of the audition, so the conditions were met; (3) and (4) are irrelevant to the conditions.
items.he_draft: המקהלה המתקדמת של קונסרבטוריון מקבלת רק מועמדים שעברו אודישן, ובתוך שבוע ממנו גם מבחן בכתב בתורת המוזיקה; נוסף על כך, מועמד מתקבל רק אם יש מקום פנוי במנעד הקול שלו. רונית עברה את האודישן ואת המבחן בכתב, אך לא התקבלה. איזה מן הבאים יכול להסביר זאת?

items.stem:
Every student in a certain boarding school participates in at least one of three activities: the orchestra, the choir and the drama club. It is known that among the students of the boarding school:
- no one who plays in the orchestra also sings in the choir.
- whoever does not participate in the drama club sings in the choir.
Which of the following is not possible?
options: Hila plays in the orchestra and does not participate in any other activity
Hila participates in the drama club and also plays in the orchestra
Every student who sings in the choir also participates in the drama club
None of the students of the boarding school plays in the orchestra
items.explanation: Orchestra only means no drama club, so by the second rule Hila sings in the choir, which the first rule forbids for an orchestra player (1). (2) breaks no rule; (3) is possible if every student is in the drama club; (4) is possible.
items.he_draft:
כל תלמיד בפנימייה מסוימת משתתף לפחות באחת משלוש פעילויות: התזמורת, המקהלה וחוג הדרמה. ידוע כי בקרב תלמידי הפנימייה:
- אף מי שמנגן בתזמורת אינו שר גם במקהלה.
- מי שאינו משתתף בחוג הדרמה שר במקהלה.
איזה מן הבאים אינו אפשרי?
(1) הילה מנגנת בתזמורת ואינה משתתפת בשום פעילות אחרת
(2) הילה משתתפת בחוג הדרמה וגם מנגנת בתזמורת
(3) כל תלמיד ששר במקהלה משתתף גם בחוג הדרמה
(4) אף אחד מתלמידי הפנימייה אינו מנגן בתזמורת

items.stem: Five members of a chess club played a tournament in which each member played one game against each of the others. None of the games ended in a draw. The club's chairman won all his games, and its youngest member lost all of his. Which of the following is necessarily true?
options: At least one of the other three players won exactly two games
The other three players each won the same number of games
The chairman won more games than any two of the other players together
No player won exactly three games
items.explanation: The three others each lost to the chairman and beat the youngest member, and played three games among themselves: either one win each (2, 2, 2 wins) or 2-1-0 (3, 2, 1 wins). Either way someone has exactly two wins (1). The 2-1-0 case refutes (2) and (4); in the 1-1-1 case two players together have 4 wins, refuting (3).
items.he_draft: במועדון שחמט שיחקו חמישה חברים טורניר שבו כל חבר שיחק משחק אחד נגד כל אחד מן האחרים. אף משחק לא הסתיים בתיקו. יושב ראש המועדון ניצח בכל משחקיו, והחבר הצעיר ביותר הפסיד בכל משחקיו. איזה מן הבאים נכון בהכרח?

items.stem: Zoologists studying a certain species of lizard hypothesized that the females lay their eggs only in sandy soil, where the eggs are protected from the heat. A survey of the area in which the species lives found that sandy soil occurs there only in a narrow strip along the coast, about two kilometers wide. A second survey, carried out a year later along the same strip, did not find a single egg of the species. Which of the following is true?
options: The first survey weakens the hypothesis, and the second adds nothing to this
The two surveys together weaken the hypothesis, although neither weakens it on its own
The second survey weakens the hypothesis, but the first strengthens it
The surveys support the hypothesis, since they show that the lizards avoid the coast, where the soil does not suit them
items.explanation: If eggs are laid only in sandy soil, the first survey places them in the coastal strip and the second finds none there - only together do they weaken the hypothesis (2). Each survey alone is compatible with it.
items.he_draft: זואולוגים שחקרו מין מסוים של לטאה שיערו שהנקבות מטילות את ביציהן רק בקרקע חולית, שבה הביצים מוגנות מן החום. סקר של האזור שבו חי המין מצא שקרקע חולית יש בו רק ברצועה צרה לאורך החוף, ברוחב של כשני קילומטרים. סקר שני, שנערך שנה לאחר מכן לאורך אותה רצועה, לא מצא אף ביצה אחת של המין. איזה מן הבאים נכון?

items.stem:
Claim A: Ofra invites to her home only people who do not invite her to theirs.
Claim B: Tzachi invites only Ofra, and Yoni invites everyone except Tzachi.
If both claims are true, Ofra -
options: invites Tzachi and Yoni
invites only Yoni
does not invite either of them
invites Tzachi, but Yoni does not invite her
items.explanation: Tzachi invites Ofra, and Yoni, who invites everyone except Tzachi, invites Ofra too; since Ofra invites only those who do not invite her, she invites neither (3). (4) fails already on its second half.
items.he_draft:
טענה א: עפרה מזמינה לביתה רק את מי שאינו מזמין אותה.
טענה ב: צחי מזמין רק את עפרה, ויוני מזמין את כולם חוץ מצחי.
אם שתי הטענות נכונות, עפרה -
(1) מזמינה את צחי ואת יוני
(2) מזמינה רק את יוני
(3) אינה מזמינה אף אחד מהם
(4) מזמינה את צחי, אך יוני אינו מזמין אותה

items.stem:
In a certain family there are four children. Their names, from the eldest to the youngest, are: Eliav, Orly, Tzuriel and Yifat. Each of them has brown eyes or blue eyes, and it is known that:
a. Eliav and Orly have eyes of different colors.
b. Every child in the family who has blue eyes has an older brother or sister with brown eyes.
Which of the following is not possible?
options: Tzuriel and Yifat both have blue eyes, like their older sister
Yifat, the youngest, is the only one in the family whose eyes are brown, apart from the eldest
Three of the children have blue eyes
Orly has brown eyes
items.explanation: Eliav has no older sibling, so by b his eyes cannot be blue; they are brown, and by a Orly's are blue - (4) is impossible. (1): Eliav is the older brown-eyed sibling of all. (2): Eliav and Yifat brown, Orly and Tzuriel blue. (3): all except Eliav blue.
items.he_draft:
במשפחה מסוימת ארבעה ילדים. שמותיהם, מן הבכור ועד הצעירה, הם: אליאב, אורלי, צוריאל ויפעת. לכל אחד מהם עיניים חומות או עיניים כחולות, וידוע כי:
א. לאליאב ולאורלי עיניים בצבעים שונים.
ב. לכל ילד במשפחה שעיניו כחולות יש אח או אחות מבוגרים ממנו שעיניהם חומות.
איזה מן הבאים אינו אפשרי?
(1) לצוריאל וליפעת עיניים כחולות, כמו לאחותם המבוגרת
(2) יפעת, הצעירה, היא היחידה במשפחה שעיניה חומות, מלבד הבכור
(3) לשלושה מן הילדים עיניים כחולות
(4) לאורלי עיניים חומות

items.stem:
Each of the four articles that were submitted to a certain journal was written in one language only - Hebrew or Arabic. It is known that of these articles:
A. only one was written in Arabic.
B. the number of articles that were rejected is greater than the number of articles in Hebrew that were accepted.
Which of the following is necessarily true?
options: The article in Arabic was rejected
At least three of the four articles were rejected
At least two of the articles in Hebrew were rejected
If the article in Arabic was accepted, then none of the articles in Hebrew was accepted
items.explanation: Let h be the number of accepted Hebrew articles and a = 1 if the Arabic one was accepted. Rejected = 4 - h - a > h gives h ≤ 1, so at least two of the three Hebrew articles were rejected (3). h = 1, a = 1 (two rejected) refutes (1), (2) and (4).
items.he_draft:
כל אחד מארבעת המאמרים שהוגשו לכתב עת מסוים נכתב בשפה אחת בלבד - עברית או ערבית. ידוע כי מבין מאמרים אלה:
א. רק אחד נכתב בערבית.
ב. מספר המאמרים שנדחו גדול ממספר המאמרים בעברית שהתקבלו.
איזה מן המשפטים הבאים נכון בהכרח?
(1) המאמר בערבית נדחה
(2) לפחות שלושה מארבעת המאמרים נדחו
(3) לפחות שניים מן המאמרים בעברית נדחו
(4) אם המאמר בערבית התקבל, אז אף אחד מן המאמרים בעברית לא התקבל

items.stem:
Five runners participated in a race, and no two of them finished at the same moment.
Given:
- Moti finished after Nava and before Shula.
- Doron finished immediately after Shula.
- Hodaya did not finish last.
Which of the following is necessarily true?
options: Nava finished first in the race
Doron finished last
Hodaya finished in second place
Shula finished before Hodaya
items.explanation: Nava, Moti and Shula finish in that order and Doron right after Shula, so the last runner is Doron or Hodaya; Hodaya was not last (2). The possible orders are H-N-M-S-D, N-H-M-S-D and N-M-H-S-D, so (1) and (3) are not necessary and (4) never holds.
items.he_draft:
חמישה רצים השתתפו במרוץ, ואף שניים מהם לא סיימו באותו רגע.
נתון:
- מוטי סיים אחרי נאוה ולפני שולה.
- דורון סיים מיד אחרי שולה.
- הודיה לא סיימה אחרונה.
איזה מן המשפטים הבאים נכון בהכרח?
(1) נאוה סיימה ראשונה במרוץ
(2) דורון סיים אחרון
(3) הודיה סיימה במקום השני
(4) שולה סיימה לפני הודיה

items.stem:
Given:
- Some of the members of the photography club in a certain town are also members of the chess club.
- None of the members of the chess club lives outside the town.
Which of the following statements about the members of the photography club is necessarily true?
options: Some of them live in the town
All of them live in the town
Most of them are also members of the chess club
If one of them lives in the town, he is also a member of the chess club
items.explanation: The members of both clubs are chess-club members, so they live in the town (1). Nothing is said about photography members who are not in the chess club, so (2), (3) and (4) do not follow.
items.he_draft:
נתון:
- חלק מחברי חוג הצילום ביישוב מסוים הם גם חברי חוג השחמט.
- אף אחד מחברי חוג השחמט אינו גר מחוץ ליישוב.
איזה מן המשפטים הבאים בנוגע לחברי חוג הצילום נכון בהכרח?
(1) חלק מהם גרים ביישוב
(2) כולם גרים ביישוב
(3) רובם חברים גם בחוג השחמט
(4) אם אחד מהם גר ביישוב, הוא חבר גם בחוג השחמט

items.stem: An agronomist claims that in the orchard that he manages, only trees that bloomed early are pruned in the winter, and that an old tree never blooms early. Which of the following claims follows from the agronomist's words?
options: If a tree in the orchard was pruned in the winter - it is not old
A young tree in the orchard that bloomed early is always pruned in the winter
If a tree in the orchard is not old, it bloomed early, but it was not necessarily pruned in the winter
Every tree that was not pruned in the winter is an old tree
items.explanation: Pruned → bloomed early → not old, so (1). (2) reverses the first rule (early blooming is necessary for pruning, not sufficient); (3) reverses the second rule; (4) reverses the whole chain.
items.he_draft:
אגרונום טוען כי במטע שהוא מנהל גוזמים בחורף רק עצים שפרחו מוקדם, וכי עץ זקן אינו פורח מוקדם לעולם. איזו מן הטענות הבאות נובעת מדברי האגרונום?
(1) אם עץ במטע נגזם בחורף - הוא אינו זקן
(2) עץ צעיר במטע שפרח מוקדם נגזם תמיד בחורף
(3) אם עץ במטע אינו זקן, הוא פרח מוקדם, אך לא בהכרח נגזם בחורף
(4) כל עץ שלא נגזם בחורף הוא עץ זקן

items.stem: According to the manufacturer of a certain incubator, whenever the temperature inside it rises above 38 degrees, a warning light comes on, and when it rises above 40 degrees, an alarm sounds as well. Which of the following, if it happened, would show that the manufacturer's claim is wrong?
options: The warning light came on when the temperature inside the incubator was only 37 degrees
The alarm sounded while the warning light was off
The temperature reached 41 degrees and the warning light came on, but the alarm did not sound
The temperature stayed at 39 degrees for an hour, during which the light was on and the alarm sounded twice
items.explanation: The claim gives sufficient conditions only: above 38 → light, above 40 → alarm. Only (3), 41 degrees without an alarm, violates it. It does not say that the light or the alarm works only in those cases, so (1), (2) and (4) do not refute it.
items.he_draft: לדברי יצרן של אינקובטור מסוים, בכל פעם שהטמפרטורה בתוכו עולה על 38 מעלות נדלקת נורת אזהרה, וכשהיא עולה על 40 מעלות נשמעת גם אזעקה. איזה מן הבאים, אילו קרה, היה מראה שטענת היצרן אינה נכונה?

items.stem: According to the regulations of a certain poetry prize, the prize can be given only to a poet who has published at least two books of poetry, at least one of them within the five years before the award. The second condition does not apply to poets who have won the prize before, but the first does. Which of the following poets definitely cannot receive the prize this year?
options: a poet who won the prize in the past and has published three books
a poet whose second book came out last year
a poet who has published two books, both of them seven years ago, and who won the prize in the past
a poet who never won the prize and whose last book, out of four, came out six years ago
items.explanation: (4) meets the first condition but has no book in the last five years and is not exempt. (1) and (3) are past winners with at least two books, so the second condition does not apply; (2) has two books, one of them last year.
items.he_draft:
על פי תקנון של פרס שירה מסוים, הפרס יכול להינתן רק למשורר שפרסם לפחות שני ספרי שירה, ואחד מהם בחמש השנים שלפני מתן הפרס. משוררים שכבר זכו בפרס בעבר פטורים מן התנאי השני, אך לא מן הראשון. איזה מן המשוררים הבאים בוודאות לא יכול לקבל את הפרס השנה?
(1) משורר שזכה בפרס בעבר ופרסם שלושה ספרים
(2) משורר שספרו השני יצא לאור בשנה שעברה
(3) משורר שפרסם שני ספרים, שניהם לפני שבע שנים, ושזכה בפרס בעבר
(4) משורר שמעולם לא זכה בפרס ושספרו האחרון, מתוך ארבעה, יצא לפני שש שנים

items.stem: Ilana told her friend that after a year of working with Yigal she had reached two conclusions about him: he will never refuse an assignment that involves travel, and it is possible that he will agree to an assignment that does not involve travel. Her friend told her that she is mistaken, and brought as proof an assignment that she had offered Yigal a month earlier. Which of the following could have been that assignment and Yigal's response to it?
options: An assignment in the office, which Yigal agreed to only after he was promised a trip later on
An assignment that did not involve any travel, and Yigal refused it
A two-day assignment in Eilat, which Yigal refused
An assignment abroad, which Yigal accepted immediately, although he had said before that he was tired of traveling
items.explanation: Only a travel assignment that Yigal refused (3) refutes "he will never refuse". The second conclusion says only that he may agree, so one refusal of a no-travel assignment (2) does not refute it; (1) and (4) are consistent with both conclusions.
items.he_draft:
אילנה סיפרה לחברתה שאחרי שנה של עבודה עם יגאל הגיעה לשתי מסקנות לגביו: הוא לעולם לא יסרב למשימה הכרוכה בנסיעה, וייתכן שיסכים למשימה שאינה כרוכה בנסיעה. חברתה אמרה לה שהיא טועה, והביאה כראיה משימה שהציעה ליגאל חודש קודם לכן. איזו מן הבאות יכולה להיות המשימה, ומה עלה בגורלה?
(1) משימה במשרד, שיגאל הסכים לה רק לאחר שהובטחה לו נסיעה בהמשך
(2) משימה שלא הייתה כרוכה בשום נסיעה, ויגאל סירב לה
(3) משימה בת יומיים באילת, שיגאל סירב לה
(4) משימה בחו"ל, שיגאל קיבל מיד, אף שאמר קודם לכן שנמאס לו לנסוע

items.stem: Eight delegates - two from each of four countries: Spain, Chile, Kenya and Japan - stayed in a hotel, two in each room, and no two delegates from the same country slept in the same room. In one of the rooms a delegate from Japan slept with a delegate from Spain. Which of the following is necessarily true?
options: In at least one of the rooms, a delegate from Kenya slept with a delegate from Chile
One of the delegates from Chile slept with a delegate from Japan
The second delegate from Japan did not sleep with the second delegate from Spain
Exactly two rooms were shared by delegates from Kenya and from Chile
items.explanation: The other three rooms hold one Japanese, one Spanish, two Chilean and two Kenyan delegates. At most two of the four Kenyans and Chileans can be paired with the Japanese and the Spanish delegate, so the other two share a room - and they cannot both be from the same country (1). The pairings J-S, K-C, K-C and K-J, K-C, C-S refute (2), (3) and (4).
items.he_draft:
שמונה נציגים - שניים מכל אחת מארבע מדינות: ספרד, צ'ילה, קניה ויפן - התארחו במלון, שניים בכל חדר, ואף שני נציגים מאותה מדינה לא לנו באותו חדר. באחד החדרים לן נציג מיפן עם נציג מספרד. איזה מן המשפטים הבאים נכון בהכרח?
(1) לפחות באחד החדרים לן נציג מקניה עם נציג מצ'ילה
(2) אחד הנציגים מצ'ילה לן עם נציג מיפן
(3) הנציג השני מיפן לא לן עם הנציג השני מספרד
(4) בדיוק שני חדרים היו משותפים לנציגים מקניה ומצ'ילה

items.stem: In a certain poetry circle, members comment on one another's poems according to a fixed rule. Under this rule, Nurit may comment on Menachem's poems but not on Tzofit's, and Tzofit may comment on Nurit's poems but not on Menachem's. Which of the following could be the rule?
options: Each member may comment on the poems of any member who joined the circle after him
A member may comment only on the poems of members whom he himself recommended for admission
Members of the same workshop group may comment on each other's poems
A member may comment on the poems of any member whose poems have not yet been published
items.explanation: (2): Nurit recommended Menachem, Tzofit recommended Nurit and not Menachem - no conflict. (1): Menachem joined after Nurit and Nurit after Tzofit, so Tzofit could comment on Menachem. (3) is symmetric, so Nurit could comment on Tzofit. (4): Nurit may comment on Menachem, so his poems are unpublished, and then Tzofit could comment on them too.
items.he_draft: בחוג שירה מסוים מעירים החברים על שיריהם של חברים אחרים לפי כלל קבוע. לפי הכלל, נורית רשאית להעיר על שיריו של מנחם אך לא על שיריה של צופית, וצופית רשאית להעיר על שיריה של נורית אך לא על שיריו של מנחם. איזה מן הבאים יכול להיות הכלל?

items.stem: The heron greets only the frog. The otter trusts all the animals except those that the heron greets, and the eagle envies all the animals except those that the otter trusts. Therefore, the eagle envies -
options: the heron and the otter
the frog only
no animal
all the animals that the heron does not greet
items.explanation: The otter trusts every animal except the frog, so the only animal the eagle envies is the frog (2). (1) and (4) name animals that the otter trusts, which the eagle therefore does not envy.
items.he_draft:
האנפה מברכת לשלום רק את הצפרדע. הלוטרה סומכת על כל בעלי החיים חוץ מאלה שהאנפה מברכת לשלום, והנשר מקנא בכל בעלי החיים חוץ מאלה שהלוטרה סומכת עליהם. לפיכך, הנשר מקנא ב-
(1) אנפה ובלוטרה
(2) צפרדע בלבד
(3) אף בעל חיים
(4) כל בעלי החיים שהאנפה אינה מברכת לשלום

items.stem: At a certain festival, every judge is a musician or a critic, but not both, and all the guests came from abroad. Adding which of the following statements makes it possible to conclude that none of the guests is a judge?
options: Whoever came from abroad is a musician and also a critic
Whoever is not a judge came from abroad
Some of the guests are musicians who do not write criticism
Every critic from abroad also plays music, though not necessarily as a professional
items.explanation: With (1) every guest is both a musician and a critic, which no judge can be. (2) reverses the needed direction; (3) says nothing about the other guests; (4) leaves room for a guest who is a musician only and is a judge.
items.he_draft:
בפסטיבל מסוים כל שופט הוא מוזיקאי או מבקר, אך לא שניהם, וכל האורחים באו מחו"ל. הוספת איזה מן המשפטים הבאים מאפשרת להסיק שאף אחד מן האורחים אינו שופט?
(1) מי שבא מחו"ל הוא מוזיקאי וגם מבקר
(2) מי שאינו שופט בא מחו"ל
(3) חלק מן האורחים הם מוזיקאים שאינם כותבים ביקורת
(4) כל מבקר מחו"ל גם מנגן, אם כי לא בהכרח כמקצוען

items.stem:
In a certain office building there are four floors.
Given:
A. Only the third floor has offices with a balcony.
B. A coffee machine can be found only in an office that has a balcony.
C. In some of the corner offices there is a coffee machine.
Which of the following does not necessarily follow from this information?
options: There is no coffee machine in any office on the fourth floor
At least one of the corner offices is on the third floor
Only corner offices have a balcony
Some of the offices that have a balcony are corner offices
items.explanation: The corner offices with a coffee machine have a balcony (B) and are on the third floor (A), which gives (2) and (4); an office on the fourth floor has no balcony and so no coffee machine (1). Nothing rules out non-corner offices with a balcony, so (3) does not follow.
items.he_draft:
בבניין משרדים מסוים ארבע קומות.
נתון:
א. משרדים עם מרפסת יש רק בקומה השלישית.
ב. מכונת קפה יכולה להימצא רק במשרד שיש לו מרפסת.
ג. בחלק מן המשרדים הפינתיים יש מכונת קפה.
איזה מן הבאים אינו נובע בהכרח ממידע זה?
(1) אין מכונת קפה באף משרד בקומה הרביעית
(2) לפחות אחד מן המשרדים הפינתיים נמצא בקומה השלישית
(3) רק למשרדים פינתיים יש מרפסת
(4) חלק מן המשרדים שיש להם מרפסת הם משרדים פינתיים

items.stem:
Below are four claims about the brothers Elad and Moshik:
A. Moshik has read the novel "The White City".
B. Elad has read every novel that Moshik has read.
C. Only one of the brothers has read "The White City".
D. Elad has read only one novel in his life.
The four claims together contain a contradiction. Which of them can be omitted without the contradiction disappearing?
options: claim A
claim B
claim C
claim D
items.explanation: A and B mean that Elad has also read "The White City", which contradicts C. The contradiction stands without D; dropping A, B or C removes it (with D, Elad's one novel is "The White City").
items.he_draft:
להלן ארבע טענות על האחים אלעד ומושיק:
א. מושיק קרא את הרומן "העיר הלבנה".
ב. כל רומן שמושיק קרא - גם אלעד קרא.
ג. רק אחד מן האחים קרא את "העיר הלבנה".
ד. אלעד קרא בחייו רומן אחד בלבד.
ארבע הטענות יחד מכילות סתירה. איזו מהן אפשר להשמיט בלי שהסתירה תיעלם?
(1) טענה א
(2) טענה ב
(3) טענה ג
(4) טענה ד

items.stem: A guide at a museum said: "Only the halls in the old wing have no air conditioning." Another guide said: "None of the halls in the old wing is air-conditioned." A visitor concluded that the hall in which the ancient maps are displayed, which is air-conditioned, is not in the old wing. On which of the guides' statements can the visitor's conclusion be based?
options: On the first guide's statement only
Only on the two statements together
On the second guide's statement, even without the first
On neither statement, even when the two are taken together
items.explanation: The second statement says: old wing → not air-conditioned; hence air-conditioned → not in the old wing (3). The first says only that halls without air conditioning are in the old wing, which leaves room for air-conditioned halls there.
items.he_draft: מדריך במוזיאון אמר: "רק באולמות האגף הישן אין מיזוג אוויר." מדריך אחר אמר: "אף אחד מאולמות האגף הישן אינו ממוזג." מבקר הסיק שהאולם שבו מוצגות המפות העתיקות, שהוא ממוזג, אינו נמצא באגף הישן. על איזו מאמירות המדריכים יכולה מסקנתו של המבקר להתבסס?

items.stem:
The owner of a bookstore claimed:
- All the books with a hard cover in the store are in Hebrew.
- Every used book in the store is signed by its author.
A customer found in the store a book that proved both claims false. Which of the following cannot be true of this book?
options: It has a soft cover
It is used and was printed abroad
It is not in Hebrew
Its author did not sign it
items.explanation: To refute the first claim the book must be a hardcover that is not in Hebrew; to refute the second it must be used and unsigned. So it is a hardcover and cannot have a soft cover (1); (2), (3) and (4) are all true of it.
items.he_draft:
בעל חנות ספרים טען:
- כל הספרים בכריכה קשה שבחנות הם בעברית.
- כל ספר משומש בחנות חתום בידי מחברו.
לקוח מצא בחנות ספר אחד שהראה ששתי הטענות אינן נכונות. מה מן הבאים לא ייתכן שנכון לגבי ספר זה?
(1) יש לו כריכה רכה
(2) הוא משומש ונדפס בחו"ל
(3) הוא אינו בעברית
(4) מחברו לא חתם עליו

items.stem:
A certain residents' committee decided on the following procedure: a proposal is accepted if a majority of the committee members vote for it. At one of the meetings, the proposal to pave the old road was accepted. Afterwards, two claims were made about this vote:
A. Every committee member who voted for the proposal lives on the hill.
B. Not one of the committee members who live on the hill voted for the proposal.
Which of the following is true?
options: Claim B follows from claim A
Claims A and B cannot both be true
If claim B is true, claim A is also necessarily true
Claim A is not consistent with the fact that the proposal was accepted
items.explanation: The proposal was accepted, so at least one member voted for it; by A he lives on the hill, and by B no one on the hill voted for it - a contradiction (2). B does not follow from A (1) nor A from B (3), and A alone is consistent with the vote if most members live on the hill (4).
items.he_draft:
ועד תושבים מסוים קבע את הנוהל הבא: הצעה מתקבלת אם רוב חברי הוועד מצביעים בעדה. באחת הישיבות התקבלה ההצעה לסלול את הדרך הישנה. לאחר מכן נטענו שתי טענות בנוגע להצבעה זו:
א. כל חבר ועד שהצביע בעד ההצעה גר על הגבעה.
ב. אף לא אחד מחברי הוועד הגרים על הגבעה הצביע בעד ההצעה.
איזה מן המשפטים הבאים נכון?
(1) טענה ב נובעת מטענה א
(2) טענות א ו-ב אינן יכולות להיות נכונות שתיהן
(3) אם טענה ב נכונה, גם טענה א נכונה בהכרח
(4) טענה א אינה מתיישבת עם העובדה שההצעה התקבלה

items.stem: In a certain museum, the old-map room is open to visitors only on Tuesdays and Thursdays. The drawers in which the maps are kept may be opened only when the curator is present, and the curator works at the museum only on Sundays, Mondays and Thursdays. Which of the following situations necessarily involves breaking one of the rules?
options: On a Thursday, a group of visitors looked at maps that the curator had taken out of the drawers for them
On a Tuesday, visitors in the old-map room were shown a map that had been taken out of its drawer that morning
On a Monday, the curator opened the drawers to check the condition of the maps while the room was closed
On a Wednesday, the room was closed and the drawers stayed locked
items.explanation: On Tuesday the curator is not at the museum, so a drawer opened that morning was opened without him (2). On Thursday both the room and the curator are available (1); (3) and (4) break no rule.
items.he_draft: במוזיאון מסוים פתוח חדר המפות הישנות למבקרים רק בימי שלישי וחמישי. את המגירות שבהן שמורות המפות מותר לפתוח רק בנוכחות האוצר, והאוצר עובד במוזיאון רק בימי ראשון, שני וחמישי. איזה מן המצבים הבאים כרוך בהכרח בהפרת אחד הכללים?

items.stem: An article on Hebrew translations states: "Of the novels of the nineteenth century that were translated into Hebrew, every one was either published in installments in a newspaper in its country of origin, or became a best seller there - but not both." Which of the following claims about four novels contradicts what is claimed in the article?
options: A novel that came out in 1850, appeared in installments in a newspaper and became a best seller, and was never translated into Hebrew
A novel that came out in 1905 and was translated into Hebrew in 1930, appeared in installments and in the same year became a best seller in its country
A novel from 1872 that was translated into Hebrew, and appeared in installments in a newspaper; however, only a few copies of it were sold in its country
A novel from 1868, translated into Hebrew in 1911, that became a best seller in its country of origin after it appeared there in installments
items.explanation: The article covers nineteenth-century novels translated into Hebrew and allows exactly one of the two traits; (4) is such a novel with both. (1) was not translated, (2) is from the twentieth century, and (3) has only one trait.
items.he_draft:
במאמר על תרגומים לעברית נכתב: "מן הרומנים של המאה התשע-עשרה שתורגמו לעברית, כל אחד פורסם בהמשכים בעיתון בארץ מוצאו, או היה שם לרב מכר - אך לא שניהם." איזו מן הטענות הבאות על ארבעה רומנים סותרת את הנטען במאמר?
(1) רומן שיצא לאור בשנת 1850, הופיע בהמשכים בעיתון והיה לרב מכר, ומעולם לא תורגם לעברית
(2) רומן שיצא לאור בשנת 1905 ותורגם לעברית בשנת 1930, הופיע בהמשכים ובאותה שנה היה לרב מכר בארצו
(3) רומן משנת 1872 שתורגם לעברית, והופיע בהמשכים בעיתון; אולם בארצו נמכרו ממנו עותקים ספורים בלבד
(4) רומן משנת 1868, שתורגם לעברית בשנת 1911, שהיה לרב מכר בארץ מוצאו לאחר שהופיע שם בהמשכים

items.stem: A swimming club allows members under 16 to swim in the deep pool only if a lifeguard is with them or if they have passed the advanced swimming test. Which of the following situations breaks the club's rule?
options: A 14-year-old who has not passed the advanced test swam in the deep pool while a lifeguard watched him
A 15-year-old who passed the advanced test last year swam alone in the deep pool
A 17-year-old who has never taken the advanced test swam alone in the deep pool
A 13-year-old who has not yet passed the advanced test swam in the deep pool with no lifeguard present
items.explanation: Under 16 in the deep pool requires a lifeguard or the advanced test; (4) has neither. (1) has a lifeguard, (2) has passed the test, and (3) is over 16.
items.he_draft: מועדון שחייה מתיר לחברים מתחת לגיל 16 לשחות בבריכה העמוקה רק אם מציל נמצא איתם או אם עברו את מבחן השחייה המתקדם. איזה מן המצבים הבאים מפר את כלל המועדון?

items.stem: Researchers who studied the speech of villages in the Galilee in the 1950s found that older residents avoided many words that young people brought back from the cities. At first the researchers assumed that the older residents did not understand these words, but they later found that most of them understood the words well and even used them when speaking with outsiders. Which of the following conclusions is best supported by these findings?
options: Most of the older residents did not understand the words that the young people brought from the cities
The young people stopped using the new words when they came back to the villages
The older residents avoided the new words mainly when speaking among themselves
The researchers' first assumption was correct with regard to only a few of the words
items.explanation: The older residents understood the words and used them with outsiders, so their avoidance was limited to talk among themselves (3). (1) contradicts the later finding; (2) and (4) are not supported (the finding was about most residents, not about some words).
items.he_draft: חוקרים שבחנו את הדיבור בכפרים בגליל בשנות החמישים מצאו שהתושבים המבוגרים נמנעו ממילים רבות שהביאו הצעירים מן הערים. תחילה הניחו החוקרים שהמבוגרים אינם מבינים את המילים, אך לאחר מכן מצאו שרובם הבינו אותן היטב, ואף השתמשו בהן כשדיברו עם אנשים מבחוץ. איזו מן המסקנות הבאות נתמכת בצורה הטובה ביותר בממצאים אלה?

items.stem: Pnina told Hezi that it was strange that their neighbor, who owns a restaurant, never cooks at home. Hezi replied that the electrician in their building had been living with a broken kitchen lamp for two years. Hezi's reply suggests that in his opinion -
options: the neighbor does not like the food served in his own restaurant
people often neglect at home the work that they do for others
the neighbor is less skilled than people think
the electrician and the neighbor are both too busy to look after their own homes
items.explanation: Hezi answers with another professional who does not do his own work at home: the thing is common, not strange (2). (4) adds a reason he does not give, and (1) and (3) are about the neighbor's restaurant, which the example does not touch.
items.he_draft: פנינה אמרה לחזי שמוזר שהשכן שלהם, שיש לו מסעדה, אינו מבשל בבית לעולם. חזי השיב שהחשמלאי שבבניין שלהם חי כבר שנתיים עם מנורה מקולקלת במטבח. מתשובתו של חזי עולה שלדעתו -

items.stem: A food factory used to check every crate that left its gates, and its inspectors found few defects. Later, to save money, the factory began to check only one crate in ten, and the number of defects found rose sharply. The factory's manager noted that during this period there had been no change in the workers, the machines or the raw materials. Which of the following can be inferred from the manager's remark?
options: The rise in the number of defects found probably reflects a change in the checking itself
The workers became less careful once they knew that most crates would not be checked
Checking one crate in ten saves money without harming the quality of the products
The more crates are checked, the fewer defects there are
items.explanation: If nothing in production changed, the rise in defects found must come from the checking (1). (2) contradicts "no change in the workers", (3) is not addressed, and (4) turns one factory's experience into a rule.
items.he_draft: מפעל מזון בדק בעבר כל ארגז שיצא משעריו, ובודקיו מצאו פגמים מעטים. מאוחר יותר, כדי לחסוך, החל המפעל לבדוק רק ארגז אחד מכל עשרה, ומספר הפגמים שנמצאו עלה בחדות. מנהל המפעל ציין שבתקופה זו לא חל שינוי בעובדים, במכונות או בחומרי הגלם. איזה מן הבאים אפשר להסיק מהערת המנהל?

items.stem: Two researchers at an experimental farm are comparing twelve plots that were sprayed this year with twelve plots that were not. Yael says: "Not one of the unsprayed plots produced a larger crop than the weakest sprayed plot." If Yael is right, which of the following is necessarily true?
options: Every sprayed plot produced a larger crop than every unsprayed plot
Most of the sprayed plots produced larger crops than most of the unsprayed plots
No sprayed plot produced a smaller crop than any unsprayed plot
The spraying increased the farm's total crop this year
items.explanation: Every unsprayed plot ≤ the weakest sprayed plot ≤ every sprayed plot (3). (1) and (2) require "larger", which fails if some crops were equal; (4) is a causal claim that does not follow.
items.he_draft: שתי חוקרות בחווה ניסיונית משוות בין שתים עשרה חלקות שרוססו השנה לבין שתים עשרה חלקות שלא רוססו. יעל אומרת: "אף אחת מן החלקות שלא רוססו לא נתנה יבול גדול יותר מן החלקה המרוססת החלשה ביותר." אם יעל צודקת, איזה מן הבאים נכון בהכרח?

items.stem: Very few complaints by villagers against tax collectors have survived in the Ottoman archives of a certain district, although the archives contain thousands of other documents from the same years, including detailed tax lists. Some historians have concluded from this that the collectors in the district were unusually fair. Others point out that complaints were often made orally to local officials and were not necessarily recorded, and that recorded complaints may have been kept in archives that did not survive. Which of the following is not implied by the paragraph?
options: The district's archives are not poor in documents from the period in question
Some historians regard the small number of complaints as evidence about the collectors' conduct
A villager could complain without leaving a written record
Most of the complaints that were written down were lost
items.explanation: The paragraph raises the loss of recorded complaints only as a possibility and says nothing about most of them (4). (1) follows from "thousands of other documents", (2) is the first view, and (3) is the oral-complaint point.
items.he_draft: בארכיוני הממשל העות'מאני של מחוז מסוים נשתמרו תלונות מעטות מאוד של כפריים נגד גובי המסים, אף שבארכיונים אלפי מסמכים אחרים מאותן שנים, ובהם רשימות מס מפורטות. כמה היסטוריונים הסיקו מכך שהגובים במחוז היו הגונים במיוחד. אחרים מציינים שתלונות הוגשו פעמים רבות בעל פה לפקידים מקומיים ולא נרשמו בהכרח, ושתלונות שנרשמו אולי נשמרו בארכיונים שלא שרדו. איזה מן הבאים אינו משתמע מן הקטע?

items.stem: The following sentence appeared in a local newspaper: "The committee rejected the proposal of the teachers' representative from the northern district." Which of the following is not a possible way of understanding the sentence?
options: The committee rejected a proposal made by the representative of the teachers of the northern district
The committee members from the northern district rejected the proposal of the teachers' representative
The committee rejected a proposal from the northern district that the teachers' representative had brought
The teachers' representative, who comes from the northern district, had his proposal rejected by the committee
items.explanation: "From the northern district" can describe the teachers, the representative or the proposal (1, 3, 4). It cannot describe the committee members who rejected it (2).
items.he_draft: בעיתון מקומי הופיע המשפט: "הוועדה דחתה את הצעת נציג המורים מן המחוז הצפוני." איזו מן הבאות אינה דרך אפשרית להבין את המשפט?

items.stem: Dafna, who sings in a youth choir, told her parents: "At the end of the year the conductor said that only a little less than two thirds of us had made the progress he had hoped for." According to Dafna, what did the conductor's words imply about the singers in the choir?
options: That a little more than a third of them had made less progress than he had hoped
That about two thirds of them had not made the progress he had hoped for
That most of them had made no progress at all
That a third of them should leave the choir
items.explanation: Those who met his hopes are a little under two thirds, so the rest - a little over a third - made less progress than he hoped (1). (2) takes the group he mentioned as the other group; (3) and (4) are not said.
items.he_draft: דפנה, השרה במקהלת נוער, סיפרה להוריה: "בסוף השנה אמר המנצח שרק מעט פחות משני שלישים מאיתנו התקדמו כפי שקיווה." על פי דפנה, מה משתמע מדברי המנצח על זמרי המקהלה?

items.stem: A worker complained to a factory's maintenance manager that all the machines in the hall where he works had stopped at the same moment. The manager replied: "When the lights go out in every room of a house at once, nobody starts replacing bulbs." Which of the following expresses the same idea as the manager's reply?
options: When a machine stops, first check whether the worker operated it properly
Old machines break down more often than new ones
A machine that stops once a week needs more attention than one that stops once a year
When all the children in a kindergarten fall ill in the same week, the doctor asks what they ate
items.explanation: A failure of everything at once points to one common cause; the doctor who looks for something all the children shared follows the same idea (4). (1), (2) and (3) are about single machines, age and frequency.
items.he_draft: פועל התלונן בפני מנהל האחזקה של מפעל שכל המכונות באולם שבו הוא עובד נעצרו באותו רגע. המנהל השיב: "כשהאור כבה בכל חדרי הבית בבת אחת, איש אינו מתחיל להחליף נורות." איזה מן הבאים מבטא את אותו רעיון כמו תשובת המנהל?

items.stem: A clerk who copied numbers from old handwritten ledgers made three kinds of mistakes: sometimes he wrote a number twice; sometimes, when the same number appeared twice in succession, he wrote it only once; and sometimes he read a 7 as a 1, since the two looked alike in the original handwriting. An auditor who compared the ledgers with the copies found four discrepancies. Which of them cannot be explained by the clerk's three kinds of mistakes?
options: The ledger shows 77 and the copy shows 17
The ledger shows 17 and the copy shows 71
The ledger shows 40, 12 and the copy shows 40, 40, 12
The ledger shows 12, 12, 9 and the copy shows 12, 9
items.explanation: (2) reverses the order of the digits, which is none of the three kinds. (1) reads the first 7 as a 1, (3) writes a number twice, and (4) writes once a number that appeared twice.
items.he_draft: פקיד שהעתיק מספרים מפנקסים ישנים בכתב יד עשה שלושה סוגי טעויות: לפעמים כתב מספר פעמיים; לפעמים, כשאותו מספר הופיע פעמיים ברציפות, כתב אותו פעם אחת בלבד; ולפעמים קרא 7 כ-1, משום שבכתב היד המקורי נראו השניים דומים. מבקר שהשווה את הפנקסים עם ההעתקים מצא ארבע אי-התאמות. איזו מהן אינה יכולה לנבוע משלושת סוגי הטעויות של הפקיד?

items.stem: Under a village's bylaws, a request to add a floor to a house can be approved only if it is submitted by a member who has lived in the village for at least ten years, or jointly by two members who have lived there for a combined total of at least fifteen years. Which of the following requests can be approved under the bylaws?
options: A request submitted jointly by a member who has lived in the village for nine years and his wife, also a member, who has lived there for five
A request by a member who moved to the village nine years ago, after living for twenty years in a neighboring village
A request submitted by the village council on behalf of a member who arrived two years ago
A request submitted jointly by two members who have each lived in the village for eight years
items.explanation: Eight plus eight is sixteen years combined (4). (1) totals fourteen, in (2) the twenty years were not in the village, and in (3) the request is not submitted by qualifying members.
items.he_draft: על פי תקנון של יישוב, בקשה להוסיף קומה לבית יכולה להיות מאושרת רק אם הגיש אותה חבר המתגורר ביישוב עשר שנים לפחות, או שהגישו אותה במשותף שני חברים שהתגוררו בו יחד בסך הכול חמש עשרה שנים לפחות. איזו מן הבקשות הבאות יכולה להיות מאושרת על פי התקנון?

items.stem:
Nava: "When a child misbehaves, the first thing to do is to ask him why."
Tzvi: "Nonsense. First you tell him to stop; there will be time for questions afterwards."
Nava: "I did not say that the questions replace stopping him. Of course he has to stop - I only think that the question should come first."
Which of the following best describes the disagreement between Nava and Tzvi?
options: They disagree about the order in which a parent should act, not about what the parent should eventually do
Nava thinks that the child's reasons matter more than stopping the behavior, whereas Tzvi thinks the opposite
Tzvi thinks that a child who misbehaves should not be asked for his reasons at all
They agree about everything, but Tzvi misunderstood Nava's first remark
items.explanation: Both want the child stopped and questioned; they differ only on what comes first (1). (2) and (3) contradict their words, and (4) ignores that they still disagree about the order.
items.he_draft: נאוה: "כשילד מתנהג רע, הדבר הראשון שצריך לעשות הוא לשאול אותו למה." צבי: "שטות. קודם אומרים לו להפסיק; לשאלות יהיה זמן אחר כך." נאוה: "לא אמרתי שהשאלות באות במקום לעצור אותו. ודאי שהוא צריך להפסיק - אני רק חושבת שהשאלה צריכה לבוא קודם." איזה מן הבאים מתאר בצורה הטובה ביותר את המחלוקת בין נאוה לצבי?

items.stem: The founder of a small theater told an interviewer that the newspapers had been wrong to describe the theater's first season as a failure. "The first performances sold out," he said. "Our problem was that people who had seen one play did not come to the next." Which of the following best summarizes the founder's claim?
options: The newspapers exaggerated the number of empty seats at the theater's first performances, which were in fact well attended
The theater had no difficulty attracting an audience, but it did have difficulty keeping one
The first plays were poor, and most of the people who came to see them left disappointed
The theater's later plays were more successful than its first ones
items.explanation: Sold-out first performances, but people did not return (2). (1) is not claimed, (3) gives a reason he does not give, and (4) contradicts his description.
items.he_draft: מייסד תיאטרון קטן אמר למראיין שהעיתונים טעו כשתיארו את העונה הראשונה של התיאטרון ככישלון. "ההצגות הראשונות נמכרו עד המקום האחרון," אמר. "הבעיה שלנו הייתה שמי שראה הצגה אחת לא בא להצגה הבאה." איזה מן הבאים מתמצת בצורה הטובה ביותר את טענת המייסד?

items.stem: A notice at the entrance to a library reads: "Books may be borrowed for two weeks. Readers who return a book late will not be allowed to borrow more than one book at a time for a month." Which of the following is consistent with the notice?
options: A reader who returned a book three days late borrowed one book a week later
A reader who returned a book late borrowed three books at once the following week
A reader kept a book for three weeks and was not restricted in any way afterwards
A reader who returned a book late borrowed two books at once three weeks later
items.explanation: After a late return the reader may borrow only one book at a time for a month; (1) keeps to this. (2) and (4) borrow several books within the month, and (3) kept the book late without the restriction that follows.
items.he_draft: בכניסה לספרייה תלויה הודעה: "ניתן לשאול ספרים לשבועיים. קורא שיחזיר ספר באיחור לא יורשה לשאול יותר מספר אחד בכל פעם במשך חודש." איזה מן הבאים מתיישב עם ההודעה?

items.stem: In an interview about his latest novel, a writer said: "This is the first book I have written that I would have shown my father without fear, had he still been alive." Which of the following can be inferred from the writer's words?
options: The writer's father read only some of his son's books
The writer considers his latest novel his best book
There is at least one earlier book that the writer would have hesitated to show his father
The writer's father had disapproved of his son's decision to become a writer and rarely read his books
items.explanation: If this is the first book he would have shown without fear, then each earlier book he would have shown with fear - in particular at least one (3). (2) turns "without fear" into "best", and (1) and (4) say things about the father that are not said.
items.he_draft: בראיון על הרומן האחרון שלו אמר סופר: "זה הספר הראשון שכתבתי שהייתי מראה לאבי בלי חשש, אילו היה עדיין בחיים." איזה מן הבאים אפשר להסיק מדברי הסופר?

items.stem: A historian who read some four hundred letters written by members of a family of grain merchants over three generations, between 1840 and 1910, found that nearly every letter mentions the current price of wheat, often in its first lines. None of the letters, however, explains why the price concerned the writers so much - even in years when, according to its account books, the family was not trading in wheat at all. Which of the following best summarizes the historian's findings?
options: The family's interest in the price of wheat stemmed from its trade in wheat
Only some of the letters mention the price of wheat, mostly in years in which the family traded in it
The account books explain what the letters do not: why the family was so interested in the price of wheat
The letters show how much the price of wheat concerned the family, but not the reason for this concern
items.explanation: Nearly every letter mentions the price, none explains the concern (4). (1) is contradicted by the years without trade, (2) reverses "nearly every", and (3) credits the account books with an explanation they do not give.
items.he_draft: היסטוריונית שקראה כארבע מאות מכתבים שכתבו בני משפחה של סוחרי תבואה במשך שלושה דורות, בין 1840 ל-1910, מצאה שכמעט כל מכתב מזכיר את מחיר החיטה, לעתים קרובות כבר בשורות הראשונות. אולם אף אחד מן המכתבים אינו מסביר מדוע העסיק המחיר את הכותבים כל כך - גם בשנים שבהן, על פי ספרי החשבונות שלה, המשפחה כלל לא סחרה בחיטה. איזה מן הבאים מתמצת בצורה הטובה ביותר את ממצאי ההיסטוריונית?

items.stem: At a council meeting, a member put a question to the head of the council and demanded a plain "yes" or "no". The head of the council refused, saying that even a person who had done nothing wrong could not answer it either way without incriminating himself. Which of the following questions could an innocent person answer with "yes" or "no" without incriminating himself?
options: Did you know about the delay in building the new school before the newspapers reported it?
Have you stopped giving council contracts to your relatives?
Was it your deputy who advised you to hide the auditor's report from the council members?
Do you regret the building permits you granted in return for money to contractors who supported you in the election?
items.explanation: An innocent person can answer (1) either way. (2), (3) and (4) take a wrongdoing for granted, so both "yes" and "no" admit it - they could be the question that was asked.
items.he_draft: בישיבת מועצה הפנה אחד החברים שאלה לראש המועצה ודרש תשובה של "כן" או "לא" בלבד. ראש המועצה סירב, ואמר שאפילו אדם שלא עשה דבר רע אינו יכול להשיב עליה בשום אחת מן הדרכים בלי להפליל את עצמו. על איזו מן השאלות הבאות יכול אדם חף מפשע להשיב "כן" או "לא" בלי להפליל את עצמו?

items.stem: This year a certain species of migrating bird arrived in Israel later than in previous years. Some attributed this to the cold winter that preceded the migration. A birdwatcher rejects this explanation: in his opinion, when there is an abundance of insects these birds arrive early, and therefore it is not reasonable that the cold winter is what delayed them. On which of the following assumptions does the birdwatcher rely?
options: In a cold winter it is difficult for the birds to find insects along the migration route
In years in which the winter is warm, the birds arrive late
A cold winter brings about an abundance of insects
Last winter was not colder than previous winters, although many people felt that it was
items.explanation: The argument works only if a cold winter → many insects → early arrival, which clashes with the late arrival; the first link is unstated (3). (1) would support the cold-winter explanation; (2) and (4) are not needed.
items.he_draft:
השנה הגיע ארצה מין מסוים של ציפור נודדת מאוחר יותר מאשר בשנים הקודמות. היו שייחסו זאת לחורף הקר שקדם לנדידה. צפר אחד דוחה הסבר זה: לדעתו, כאשר יש שפע של חרקים מגיעות ציפורים אלה מוקדם, ולכן אין זה סביר שהחורף הקר הוא שעיכב אותן. על איזו מן ההנחות הבאות מסתמך הצפר?
(1) בחורף קר קשה לציפורים למצוא חרקים לאורך מסלול הנדידה
(2) בשנים שבהן החורף חם, הציפורים מגיעות מאוחר
(3) חורף קר מביא לשפע של חרקים
(4) החורף שעבר לא היה קר מן החורפים הקודמים, אף שאנשים רבים חשו שהיה

items.stem: A young writer complained to a friend: "I gave the editor two pages and a twenty-page story at the same time. He finished the story that evening, but kept the two pages for a week." Her friend replied: "That does not mean that he preferred the story." Which of the following, if true, best supports the friend's reply?
options: The editor usually rejects short texts submitted by young writers
The editor believes that in a short text every word must be weighed carefully
Long stories are easier to write than short texts
The editor published the twenty-page story in the next issue of his journal
items.explanation: If short texts demand that every word be weighed, the week spent on two pages reflects care, not preference (2). (1) and (4) support the opposite, and (3) is about writing, not reading.
items.he_draft: סופרת צעירה התלוננה בפני חברתה: "נתתי לעורך בבת אחת שני עמודים וסיפור בן עשרים עמודים. את הסיפור הוא סיים באותו ערב, ואת שני העמודים החזיק שבוע." חברתה השיבה: "זה לא אומר שהוא העדיף את הסיפור." איזה מן הבאים, אם הוא נכון, תומך בצורה הטובה ביותר בתשובת החברה?

items.stem: In an article on school reading lists, the author writes that she agrees with those who want students to choose their own books, but not with their arguments. The only good argument for such a choice, in her view, is that choosing what to read teaches young people to judge for themselves. Which of the following could be one of the arguments that the author rejects?
options: Students who choose their own books gradually learn to decide for themselves which books are worth reading
Students whose teachers chose their books read more classics than students who chose for themselves
Only experienced teachers know which books will develop independent judgment
Students who chose their own books at school tend to go on reading after they leave school
items.explanation: The argument she rejects must support free choice and differ from her own; (4) is such an argument. (1) is her own argument in other words, and (2) and (3) argue against free choice.
items.he_draft: במאמר על רשימות קריאה בבתי ספר כותבת המחברת שהיא מסכימה עם מי שרוצים שהתלמידים יבחרו את ספריהם בעצמם, אך לא עם נימוקיהם. לדעתה, הנימוק הטוב היחיד לבחירה כזאת הוא שבחירת הספרים מלמדת צעירים לשפוט בעצמם. איזה מן הבאים יכול להיות אחד הנימוקים שהמחברת דוחה?

items.stem: Below is a sentence from which a word or phrase is missing: "____ the long delay, the passengers waited patiently on the platform." In which of the following sentences could the same word or phrase be missing?
options: ____ the heat wave, many residents spent the weekend at the beach
The festival was canceled ____ the storm
____ the warnings of the weather service, hundreds of hikers set out on the trail
____ the new road that was opened last year, the trip from the city to the village now takes half as long
items.explanation: The missing phrase is "Despite" (or "In spite of"), which fits only (3). (1) and (2) need "Because of", and (4) needs "Thanks to".
items.he_draft: לפניכם משפט שחסרה בו מילה או צירוף: "____ העיכוב הארוך, הנוסעים חיכו ברציף בסבלנות." באיזה מן המשפטים הבאים יכולים להיות חסרים אותה מילה או אותו צירוף?

items.stem:
Shimrit, back from a weekend at the lake, told her friend Orna: "My uncle, who lives near the lake, told me that yesterday he saw Tova rowing with the university team, and that she looked very happy."
Orna replied: "I did not know that your uncle rows on the university team."
Orna apparently understood that -
options: Shimrit's uncle was one of the rowers
Tova is a member of the university team
Shimrit's uncle was happy to see Tova
Tova rowed on the lake every day that week
items.explanation: "Rowing with the university team" can describe Tova or the uncle; Orna's reply shows she took it to describe the uncle (1). (2) is what Shimrit meant, and (3) and (4) are not in the sentence.
items.he_draft: שמרית, שחזרה מסוף שבוע ליד האגם, סיפרה לחברתה אורנה: "הדוד שלי, שגר ליד האגם, סיפר לי שאתמול הוא ראה את טובה חותרת עם נבחרת האוניברסיטה, ושהיא נראתה מאושרת מאוד." אורנה השיבה: "לא ידעתי שהדוד שלך חותר בנבחרת האוניברסיטה." נראה שאורנה הבינה ש-

items.stem: In the introduction to a collection of letters written by settlers in the Galilee in the early twentieth century, the editor warns readers that the letters were not written for historians. Most were sent to relatives abroad whom the writers wanted to reassure, and they say little about hardship. The letters are therefore an important source, the editor writes, but not a complete picture of life in the settlements. Which of the following is implied in the introduction?
options: The settlers wrote more letters to their relatives abroad than to one another
The editor believes that letters are not a reliable source for historical research
Most of the settlers who wrote the letters later returned to their countries of origin
Life in the settlements was probably harder than the letters suggest
items.explanation: The writers played down hardship to reassure their relatives, so life was probably harder than the letters show (4). (1) confuses the letters in the collection with all letters written, (2) contradicts "an important source", and (3) is not mentioned.
items.he_draft: בהקדמה לקובץ מכתבים שכתבו מתיישבים בגליל בראשית המאה העשרים מזהיר העורך את הקוראים שהמכתבים לא נכתבו בשביל היסטוריונים. רובם נשלחו לקרובים בחוץ לארץ, שהכותבים רצו להרגיע, והם מספרים מעט על הקשיים. לכן, כותב העורך, המכתבים הם מקור חשוב, אך לא תמונה שלמה של החיים ביישובים. איזה מן הבאים משתמע מן ההקדמה?

items.stem: After a mathematics exam, several students complained to their teacher that the questions were not like the exercises they had practiced in class. The teacher answered: "Someone who has learned only the way from his house to the grocery store is lost the day the store moves." In his answer, the teacher compares -
options: the students who complained to people who have never left their own neighborhood
learning only the way to the store to learning only the practiced exercises
the classroom in which the exercises were practiced to the house from which the way begins
the store's move to the students' complaint
items.explanation: Knowing one fixed route is like knowing only the practiced exercises, and the store's move is like the new questions (2). (4) matches the move to the complaint instead of the exam; (1) and (3) match people and places that play no part in the comparison.
items.he_draft: אחרי בחינה במתמטיקה התלוננו כמה תלמידים בפני המורה שהשאלות לא דמו לתרגילים שתרגלו בכיתה. המורה ענה: "מי שלמד רק את הדרך מביתו למכולת הולך לאיבוד ביום שבו המכולת עוברת." בתשובתו משווה המורה -

items.stem: An architect who designed several kibbutz dining halls in the 1950s recalled that the planners had tried to fit each hall to the members' way of life. Within a few years, he said, it was the other way round: where people sat, whom they met and even how the general meetings were run were determined by the layout of the hall. Which of the following best describes the change that the architect noticed?
options: Buildings that were designed to suit a way of life came to shape that way of life
The halls suited the members in the 1950s, but not the way of life that developed later
The planners ignored the members' way of life when they designed the halls
The members disliked the halls but had no choice but to adapt to them
items.explanation: The halls were planned to follow the members' life and ended up shaping it (1). (2) reverses the direction of influence, (3) contradicts the planners' effort, and (4) adds dissatisfaction.
items.he_draft: אדריכל שתכנן כמה חדרי אוכל בקיבוצים בשנות החמישים סיפר שהמתכננים ניסו להתאים כל חדר אוכל לאורח החיים של החברים. בתוך שנים ספורות, אמר, התהפך הדבר: היכן אנשים ישבו, את מי פגשו ואפילו כיצד התנהלו האסיפות הכלליות - כל אלה נקבעו לפי מבנה האולם. איזה מן הבאים מתאר בצורה הטובה ביותר את השינוי שהבחין בו האדריכל?

items.stem: A music critic wrote about a certain singer: "Many people believe that her early recordings are weaker than her later ones, and point to the fact that for years hardly anyone bought them. But the public was slow to appreciate them for reasons that had nothing to do with the recordings themselves, and anyone who listens to them today will find them no less moving than her later work." Which of the following best expresses the critic's main point?
options: The public now prefers the singer's early recordings to her later ones
The singer's later recordings are better, which is why they sold more
Poor sales of the early recordings are no evidence that they are inferior to her later ones
The early recordings sold poorly because of the poor technical conditions in which they were made, unlike the later ones
items.explanation: The critic rejects the inference from poor sales to lower quality (3). (2) is the view he argues against, (4) gives a reason connected to the recordings themselves, which he denies, and (1) claims a present preference he does not mention.
items.he_draft: מבקר מוזיקה כתב על זמרת מסוימת: "רבים סבורים שהקלטותיה המוקדמות חלשות מן המאוחרות, ומצביעים על כך שבמשך שנים כמעט איש לא קנה אותן. אבל הציבור היה איטי להעריך אותן מסיבות שאין להן כל קשר להקלטות עצמן, ומי שיאזין להן היום ימצא שהן מרגשות לא פחות מעבודתה המאוחרת." איזה מן הבאים מבטא בצורה הטובה ביותר את עיקר דבריו של המבקר?

items.stem: In a letter to a local newspaper, a resident writes that he voted against moving the market out of the town center, and that he still thinks the decision was taken too hastily. Nevertheless, he admits, the streets of the center have been cleaner since the move - the very thing that the plan's opponents, himself included, had said would not happen. Which of the following is not implied by the letter?
options: The plan's opponents did not expect the move to make the center cleaner
The resident still has reservations about the way the decision was made
At least one of the opponents' predictions turned out to be wrong
Since the move, the resident has come to support moving the market
items.explanation: He concedes only that the streets are cleaner and still criticizes the decision, so nothing implies that he now supports the move (4). (1) and (3) follow from "said would not happen", and (2) from "still thinks ... too hastily".
items.he_draft: במכתב לעיתון מקומי כותב תושב שהצביע נגד העברת השוק ממרכז העיר, ושהוא עדיין סבור שההחלטה התקבלה בחיפזון. עם זאת, הוא מודה, רחובות המרכז נקיים יותר מאז ההעברה - בדיוק מה שמתנגדי התוכנית, והוא בכללם, אמרו שלא יקרה. איזה מן הבאים אינו משתמע מן המכתב?

items.stem: A philosopher once remarked that a man who announces that he is the humblest person in the village has not only praised himself but, by the very announcement, has shown that he does not deserve the praise, whereas a man who announces that he is the proudest person in the village may be telling the truth. Which of the following best expresses the philosopher's point?
options: Anyone who praises himself is lying
A proud man who openly admits his pride shows by doing so that he is in fact humble
Declaring oneself humble, unlike declaring oneself proud, undermines the very claim being made
A man who is truly humble does not say anything about his own character, whether good or bad
items.explanation: Announcing one's humility is itself immodest, whereas announcing one's pride can be true (3). (1) contradicts "may be telling the truth", and (2) and (4) are not said.
items.he_draft: פילוסוף העיר פעם שאדם המכריז שהוא הצנוע באנשי הכפר לא רק שיבח את עצמו, אלא בעצם ההכרזה הראה שאינו ראוי לשבח, ואילו אדם המכריז שהוא הגאוותן באנשי הכפר אולי אומר אמת. איזה מן הבאים מבטא בצורה הטובה ביותר את כוונת הפילוסוף?
